'''GrandWORMTarkin your not gonna profit by this deck...youll be destroyed!''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[GrandWORMTarkin]]
* '''Published:''' 8 December 2001 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Can Either Profit By This...|EJP-L-youcaneitherprofitbythis.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' You Can Either Profit By This...
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTat Profit GrandWORMTarkin LS 2001 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

We all know about good objectives. Some use hidden Base while others choose to use the more tedious deck...there is still good in him. The deck that I use is a proit deck. A profit deck that is sure to be for the opponent most unprofitable!

The published list has 58 cards.

== Strategy ==

realy when you build this deck you wanna make sure han dosnt get re-captured. i chose tk-422 so youll be retrieving 10 force.cards like no desintigrations and arc welders and droids are just in case you face a bounty hunter deck. i had to take out interupts to make room for podracing. pods will help later in the game when both sifes are down on force and the winner will be put to the top while the loser well... loses. you will also see that many of my cards are not immune to sense and alter. thats why i have do or do not and wise advice. now some will say that power three cards are a waste of time. but... if you play them right they are very handy. i added up the power for space and ground. i have a little over 55 power each. i also have many lightsabers. need i explaine? and finaly me 2 mon calamari ships. i am well aware of the fact that they only deploy to mon calmari. if you dont get mon calmari its simple...use them to satisfy force drains. if you get keia and someone who loves you out then they're as good as bck in your hand.
